description: This file defines configuration flag classes and components within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, utilizing the Fruit dependency injection framework, and declares interfaces for system image directory flags and general configuration flags.

classes.name: SystemImageDirFlag
classes.description: An interface class representing a flag for system image directory, with a method to retrieve the directory path.

classes.name: ConfigFlag
classes.description: A class representing a general configuration flag, inherited from FlagFeature.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the path of the system image directory.

methods.name: ConfigFlagComponent
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection component providing SystemImageDirFlag and ConfigFlag.

methods.name: ConfigFlagPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection placeholder component for ConfigFlag.
